say:1:1460429001:1.text: Judging from the time you went out and the direction you took, you must have run into Taria and Matlow, right?

say:3:1460429003:1.text: Come on, do you really think I'd go to all that trouble?

say:4:1460429004:1.source_cn: ……我真该随身带一瓶药随时给你灌。
